actions.label: Create WAN connection
actions.note: Stock: set_inst(OBJ_ETHWANCPPP_ID|OBJ_ETHWANCIP_ID|OBJ_ETHWANCBRIDGE_ID, '') with IF_ACTION=new; libcmapi then creates WANCD(+MultiWancd) IGD.WD1.WCDn, WANC + WANCPPP/WANCIP with the same ViewName IGD.WD1.WCDn.WCPPPm|WCIPm, WANCEXT, WANCServList rows and port binding. A raw sidbg implementation must add and link all of these (see notes/network.md).

actions.label: Delete WAN connection
actions.note: Stock: del_inst(<type OBJ>, identity). Must remove WANC + WANCPPP/WANCIP row with that ViewName, the WANCEXT/WANCServList rows pointing at it and the WANCD/MultiWancd row if it becomes empty.

actions.label: Connect PPPoE
actions.note: dev_action CmdId=cmd_pppconnect Identity=<WANC view> (stock button for manual dial).

actions.label: Release DHCP lease
actions.note: dev_action CmdId=cmd_dhcpdisconnect on the IPoE connection.

actions.label: Renew DHCP lease
actions.note: dev_action CmdId=cmd_dhcpconnect on the IPoE connection.

pages.notes: One stock OBJ (OBJ_ETHWANCPPP_ID/IP/BRIDGE) spans WANC (common), WANCPPP or WANCIP (type-specific), WANCEXT (DHCP server toggle), WANCServList (apps), WANCD/MultiWancd (VLAN container). Rows join on ViewName (WANC.ViewName == WANCPPP/WANCIP.ViewName == WANCEXT.WANCViewName == WANCServList.WANCViewName; WANC.WANCDViewName == WANCD.ViewName == MultiWancd.WCDViewName). Row numbers differ per table. IPv6 WAN parameters (GUASrc, DNSv6Src, Gatewayv6Src, PrefixSrc, GUA1, Prefix1, IPv6CPExt) have no DB table in the dump: runtime/unknown. Enum codes from libcmapi.so tables (ref fw): tWANCAPPConnTypeTable, tWancPPPConnTriggerTable, tWancPPPAuthTypeTable, tWANCIPAddressingTypeTable, tWANCIpModeTable, tWANCDLINKType, tWANCApplicationTable. UI-text notes moved here: [WANCName]: Generated by the stock firmware (e.g. <n>_INTERNET_R_VID_<vlan>); not user-editable in the stock page. | [ConnType]: Routed WAN = 1, PPPoE pass-through bridge = 4 (stock user page offers exactly these two). | [WANCType]: Internal WANC kind code; observed 0 on the factory PPP row. Meaning not decoded. | [ServList]: Bitmask INTERNET=1, TR069=2, VoIP=4, OTHER=8. StrServList must be kept in sync. | [StrServList]: Text twin of ServList written by the stock JS (SERVICELIST_PARA[ServList]). | [IsNAT]: Stock forces 0 for TR069/VoIP-only services and IPv6-only. | [WBDMode]: Stock web values: 0 UnTag, 1 Transparency, 2 Tag (VLAN ID 1-4094 required when tagged). | [Priority]: Stock writes 0 unless the VLAN mode is Tagged. | [MCVLANID]: -1 = none. Stock page parameter is spelled MCVlANID; the DB DM is MCVLANID. | [DSCP]: -1 = DSCP marking disabled; 0-63 when 'Enable DSCP' is ticked. | [MTU]: Stock: 128-1492 (IPv4 PPPoE); 1280-1492 when IPv6 is enabled. | [MaxUser]: Upper bound comes from the firmware config key ProxyMaxUser. | [DNS1]: 0.0.0.0 = unset (stock writes 0.0.0.0 for blanks). | [MTU]: Stock: static 128-1500, DHCP 576-1500, IPv6 1280-1500. | [LinkType]: Always 1 (oE) on GPON. | [VlanMode]: Observed 1 and 2. Probably the same 0/1/2 coding as WANC.WBDMode; unverified. | [DhcpEnable]: Stock 'Enable DHCP Server' checkbox (page param dhcpEnable); forced 0 for TR069/VoIP-only. | [bitBind]: Stock string of 0/1 per port: LAN1..LAN4 then SSID1..SSIDn. | ConnType option codes: 1 IP_Routed, 2 IP_Bridged, 3 DHCP_Spoofed, 4 PPPoE_Bridged, 5 PPPoE_Relay, 6 PPTP_Relay, 7 L2TP_Relay.
